question: Do fixed labels, unordered divisor selection, sparse orbit bases, covering partitions or hybrid presentations reduce complete verified APS cost against the matched native baseline?
decision_value: A held-out reduction in complete cold cost, including setup and failed attempts, establishes an IC improvement and chooses the next baseline. A null, failed, budget-exhausted or price-sensitive result is retained and does not promote a winner. Tiny correctness tests alone do not decide this comparison.
